title: `voids/interested-party-void` misreads four of its philosophical sources. It deploys Alston for "No technical fix awaits this limitation" without the non-sceptical moral the 2026-11-25 deep review restored on `voids/necessary-opacity`. It inverts Nietzsche, who makes inspecting the will to truth the task (GM III §§24, 27). It enlarges Smilansky's free-will claim to "beliefs about consciousness". It quotes an unverified Nagel phrase. Its Buddhist paragraph is uncited.
